# Synthetic trust-game fixture

`synthetic_game_log3.json` is a capability-test fixture copied from:

`RQ1_old_result/result_trust_game_population/30lun_3ci_012404_deepseek-r1/data/game_log2.json`

Only four explanation fields in interactions 1–3 were deliberately rewritten.
All decisions, payoffs, pairings, timestamps, and other experimental values remain
duplicates of the source file.

This file is synthetic and must not be used as an independent experimental run or
included in RQ1 statistical analysis.
